hotels.title: China French-Inspired Zhengzhou Retreat with Indoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Step into a world where East meets West at this trendy hotel, your sophisticated haven in central China's bustling economic hub. The blend of French art de vivre and local Henan culture creates spaces where business travellers unwind in style and leisure guests discover unexpected luxury, all while enjoying panoramic views of the city skyline and ancient Yellow River valley beyond. From the moment you're greeted by friendly staff, you'll feel the difference in the approach to hospitality. Savour exquisite cuisine at signature restaurants or indulge in world-class spa treatments. Moments from Erqi Memorial Tower, the historic Shang Dynasty ruins and Zhengzhou's top shopping district, this hotel puts the city's treasures at your fingertips.
